note: npm audit --omit=dev advisories, tracked by distinct advisory id (npm's via.source), with package and severity. An advisory id absent from this baseline fails the audit stage; one that disappears prints a tighten hint. Production dependencies have no advisories.

withDevDependencies.note: npm's own metadata.vulnerabilities count from plain npm audit --json, which counts affected packages (each given its single worst severity) rather than distinct advisory ids. Information only, not used for gating.
